answer: A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a fleet in one epoch however much capital it holds, since every identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The comet cap is policed at intake and whisper exposes the per-origin counts. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a trellis tag. That is 32 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
